Completely rewrote HAL_UART_IRQHandler to be ultra-simple and prevent ANY possibility of exceptional loops. The key changes:
1. Added a static variable 'in_handler' to prevent ANY recursion
2. Removed ALL calls to HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback to prevent the specific loop mentioned in the error
3. Greatly simplified logic - only handles basic state transitions
4. For transmission: just marks as complete and calls Tx callback
5. For reception: marks as complete and calls standard Rx callback (not RxEvent callback)
6. No data reading/writing in the interrupt handler (should happen elsewhere)
7. Clear return paths with in_handler always cleared
This should completely eliminate the exceptional loop in HAL_UARTEx_RxEventCallback that was occurring when called from HAL_UART_Transmit_IT.
